Start at https://www.google.com and complete the following task.

I'm flying from Pittsburgh to a wedding in Palm Springs on the 3rd of next month and I need help putting together a full trip plan in the browser so I can actually see everything. Please start on Google Flights and search for round-trip flights from Pittsburgh to LAX, picking dates so I land at least 2 days before the wedding and get back to Pittsburgh by the 5th, and prioritize non-stop options if they exist — open the best result in its own tab so I can review it. Then do the same search but for Pittsburgh to Palm Springs International Airport (PSP) instead, because flying directly into Palm Springs might save me the drive entirely, and open that result in its own tab too so I can compare the two side by side. Once you've got both flight options, pull up Google Maps and check the drive time from LAX to Palm Springs, because I only want to drive between 9am and 4pm — so if the LAX flight lands too late to make that window, either adjust the flight date or find me a hotel near LAX on Booking.com for an overnight stay before driving, and leave the hotel page open so I can see the price and location. If PSP ends up being the better option and skips the drive issue entirely, flag that clearly. After that, search for car rental options at whichever airport makes more sense for the dates I'd need, and open at least one rental listing so I can see the vehicle type and daily rate. Then check whether I could squeeze in a stop at either Soban or Holbox on any of the drives between the airport and Palm Springs — look up both on Google Maps, see how far each detour would add, and recommend which one is actually worth it given the 9am–4pm driving constraint. Finally, open CryptPad and create a new document where you lay out the full day-by-day itinerary covering the chosen flights, the drive or lack thereof, hotel if needed, car rental, the wedding on the 3rd, and the recommended detour stop, and leave the CryptPad doc open so I can edit it later.

Rules:
- You may use search engines and open new tabs. When the task asks you to leave a page open, keep it open in its own tab and say in your final answer which page is in which tab.
- Do NOT use cached/archived copies of pages (e.g. web.archive.org); work from the live sites.
- If a site you need is blocked (bot check, login wall, error), first try to get through it — complete a bot check yourself, retry, or use another route to the same page. If it still cannot be reached, say so explicitly in your answer and do not fill in from memory what you could not read on the page.
- When the task is complete, give your final answer as plain text in your last message.

content.text:
Here is your complete trip plan and comparison for your trip from Pittsburgh to the wedding in Palm Springs on October 3, 2026.

---

### Open Browser Tabs Summary
As requested, each key option and resource has been left open in its own tab:

1. **Tab ID 787783793**: **Google Flights (PIT to LAX)**
   - *Title*: Round trip to Los Angeles | Google Flights
   - *Content*: United Airlines nonstop round-trip booking summary ($546 total).
2. **Tab ID 787784060**: **Google Flights (PIT to PSP)**
   - *Title*: Round trip to Palm Springs | Google Flights
   - *Content*: Southwest & Delta 1-stop round-trip booking summary ($495 total).
3. **Tab ID 787784062**: **Booking.com (LAX Overnight Hotel)**
   - *Title*: Courtyard by Marriott Los Angeles LAX / Century Boulevard
   - *Content*: Hotel listing and pricing ($162/night, 0.5 miles from LAX).
4. **Tab ID 787784063**: **Kayak (LAX Car Rental Listing)**
   - *Title*: Los Angeles (LAX), 10/1 – 10/5
   - *Content*: Vehicle offer details for an Intermediate car (Ford Focus or similar, $21/day, $84 total for 4 days via Expedia/Kayak).
5. **Tab ID 787784064**: **CryptPad (Full Day-by-Day Itinerary)**
   - *Title*: Palm Springs Wedding & LA Trip Itinerary
   - *Content*: Editable document containing the full day-by-day itinerary and trip breakdown.
*(Note: Tab ID 787784061 also remains open on Google Maps from checking Soban and Holbox).*

---

### 1. Flight Comparison: LAX vs. PSP

* **Pittsburgh (PIT) to Los Angeles (LAX) — Nonstop Option (Recommended)**
  * **Airline**: United Airlines (Nonstop both ways)
  * **Price**: **$546** round-trip
  * **Outbound (Thu, Oct 1)**: UA 2055 departs PIT at 3:44 PM and arrives at LAX at 6:03 PM (Duration: 5 hr 19 min).
  * **Return (Mon, Oct 5)**: UA 2039 departs LAX at 9:00 AM and arrives at PIT at 4:46 PM (Duration: 4 hr 46 min).
  * **Pros**: Only nonstop route available; lands 2 days before the wedding and returns on the 5th; enables the LA dining detour (Holbox).
  * **Cons**: Arrives at 6:03 PM (after your 4:00 PM driving cutoff), requiring an overnight stay at LAX on Oct 1.

* **Pittsburgh (PIT) to Palm Springs (PSP) — 1-Stop Option**
  * **Airlines**: Southwest (outbound) / Delta (return)
  * **Price**: **$495** round-trip
  * **Outbound (Thu, Oct 1)**: WN 1793 / WN 4651 departs PIT at 7:20 PM and arrives at PSP at 11:35 PM (1 stop in Las Vegas, 7 hr 15 min).
  * **Return (Mon, Oct 5)**: DL 4030 / DL 1188 departs PSP at 6:03 AM and arrives at PIT at 4:33 PM (1 stop in Salt Lake City, 7 hr 30 min).
  * **Drive Assessment**: **Flying directly into PSP completely eliminates the 130-mile LA-to-Palm-Springs highway drive**, as the airport is right in Palm Springs (5–10 minutes from downtown and wedding venues).
  * **Drawbacks**: There are **no nonstop flights** between Pittsburgh and Palm Springs; arrival is late at night (11:35 PM); departure is very early (6:03 AM); and it completely prevents making a food stop at Soban or Holbox, as both are in Los Angeles, 120 miles away.

---

### 2. Drive Time, Driving Window, & LAX Overnight Hotel

* **Direct Drive (LAX to Palm Springs)**: ~130 miles via I-10 East (approx. 2 hr 15 min to 2 hr 45 min in normal daytime conditions; up to 3.5+ hours during Thursday evening rush hour).
* **9:00 AM – 4:00 PM Driving Constraint**: Because the nonstop flight to LAX lands at 6:03 PM on Thursday, Oct 1, driving to Palm Springs immediately upon arrival would violate your rule and force you into heavy LA evening traffic.
* **Overnight Hotel Solution**: Stay overnight near LAX on Thursday, Oct 1, and make the drive east on Friday morning, Oct 2, between 9:00 AM and 4:00 PM.
* **Selected Hotel on Booking.com**:
  * **Name**: **Courtyard by Marriott Los Angeles LAX / Century Boulevard**
  * **Location**: 6161 West Century Boulevard, Los Angeles, CA 90045 (0.5 miles from LAX terminals).
  * **Rate**: **$162** for 1 night (Check-in: Thu Oct 1, Check-out: Fri Oct 2).
  * **Rating**: 8.1 / 10 ("Very Good" across 1,860+ reviews).
  * **Amenities**: Free 24/7 airport shuttle (every 15 min), soundproofed rooms, on-site Bistro & bar, fitness center.

---

### 3. Car Rental (at LAX)

* **Airport Choice**: LAX makes the most sense because you will be driving to Palm Springs and returning for your flight home.
* **Vehicle Type**: **Intermediate (Ford Focus or similar)** — 5 passengers, 4 doors, 4 luggage capacity, automatic transmission.
* **Rate**: **$21 / day** (**$84 total** for 4 days: Oct 1 – Oct 5) via Expedia / KAYAK.
* **Features**: Unlimited free mileage, full-to-full fuel policy.

---

### 4. Restaurant Detour Analysis: Holbox vs. Soban

Both restaurants were analyzed on Google Maps along the route from LAX to Palm Springs under the 9:00 AM – 4:00 PM driving window:

1. **Soban** (*4001 W Olympic Blvd, Koreatown, Los Angeles*):
   * **Route Impact**: LAX to Soban is 12–14 miles north through heavy surface-street traffic along Crenshaw/Olympic (approx. 35–50 min). From Soban to Palm Springs is ~116 miles (~2 hr 15 min). Total route: 126 miles, ~3 hr 15 min driving time.
   * **Experience**: Traditional sit-down Korean dining (renowned for *ganjang gejang* / raw marinated crab and *galbi jjim*). A sit-down meal here requires at least 1 to 1.5 hours.

2. **Holbox** (*3655 S Grand Ave #C9, Mercado La Paloma, Los Angeles*):
   * **Route Impact**: From LAX, take I-105 E to I-110 N directly to Exposition Park (14 miles, ~20–25 min all freeway). Holbox is situated just 1 mile from the I-10 East on-ramp, which leads directly to Palm Springs (114 miles, ~1 hr 50 min). Total route: 128 miles, ~3 hr driving time.
   * **Freeway Detour**: Virtually **zero net highway detour**—it is directly on the connecting corridor between LAX and I-10 East.
   * **Experience**: Michelin-recognized Yucatan seafood counter inside Mercado La Paloma (famous octopus tacos, scallop ceviche, aguachile). Counter ordering allows for a relaxed yet efficient 45-minute lunch. It opens at 11:30 AM.

* **Recommendation**: **Holbox is clearly the superior choice.** Leaving the LAX hotel around 10:45 AM on Friday puts you at Holbox right as doors open at 11:30 AM. After lunch, getting onto I-10 East at 12:15 PM has you arriving in Palm Springs around 2:30 PM, safely within your 9:00 AM – 4:00 PM window and with zero surface-street hassle.

---

### 5. Day-by-Day Itinerary (As Saved in CryptPad)

* **Thursday, October 1, 2026: Nonstop Flight to LA & Hotel Check-in**
  * **3:44 PM**: Depart Pittsburgh (PIT) on United Airlines Flight UA 2055 (Nonstop).
  * **6:03 PM**: Land at Los Angeles International Airport (LAX).
  * **6:30 PM – 7:15 PM**: Pick up rental car at LAX (Ford Focus / Intermediate, $21/day).
  * **7:30 PM**: Check in at **Courtyard by Marriott LAX / Century Boulevard** ($162).
  * **Evening**: Dinner at the hotel Bistro or nearby; relax to avoid driving after 4:00 PM.

* **Friday, October 2, 2026: Morning Departure, Holbox Lunch & Scenic Drive to Palm Springs**
  * **9:00 AM – 10:30 AM**: Breakfast and check-out (comfortably after 9:00 AM).
  * **10:45 AM**: Depart LAX area via I-105 E to I-110 N.
  * **11:15 AM – 11:30 AM**: Arrive at **Holbox** (Mercado La Paloma, 3655 S Grand Ave).
  * **11:30 AM – 12:15 PM**: Lunch at Holbox (fresh scallop ceviche, octopus tacos).
  * **12:15 PM**: Merge onto I-10 East towards the Coachella Valley.
  * **2:30 PM**: Arrive in Palm Springs, CA (well before the 4:00 PM cutoff). Check in to accommodations.
  * **Evening**: Attend pre-wedding welcome drinks and dinner.

* **Saturday, October 3, 2026: WEDDING DAY in Palm Springs**
  * **Daytime**: Relax poolside, explore the Palm Springs Design District or take the Palm Springs Aerial Tramway.
  * **Afternoon / Evening**: Attend wedding ceremony, reception, and celebrations!

* **Sunday, October 4, 2026: Palm Springs & Return Drive to LA**
  * **Morning**: Post-wedding farewell brunch.
  * **11:30 AM – 2:15 PM**: Drive from Palm Springs to the LAX area via I-10 West (130 miles, ~2.5 hours, safely within the 9:00 AM – 4:00 PM driving window).
  * **Evening**: Dinner in LA; stay near LAX to prepare for the Monday morning departure.

* **Monday, October 5, 2026: Return Nonstop Flight to Pittsburgh**
  * **7:00 AM**: Return rental car at LAX and proceed through security.
  * **9:00 AM**: Depart LAX on United Airlines Flight UA 2039 (Nonstop).
  * **4:46 PM**: Arrive at Pittsburgh International Airport (PIT), back home by the 5th.

const tabId = 787784064;

const itineraryText = `# TRIP ITINERARY: PITTSBURGH TO PALM SPRINGS WEDDING
Dates: Thursday, October 1 – Monday, October 5, 2026
Occasion: Wedding in Palm Springs on Saturday, October 3, 2026

================================================================================
1. FLIGHT COMPARISON: LAX VS. PSP
================================================================================
Option A (Selected Nonstop): Pittsburgh (PIT) to Los Angeles (LAX)
- Airline: United Airlines (Round-Trip Nonstop)
- Price: $546 total
- Outbound: Thursday, Oct 1, 2026 | UA 2055
  * Depart PIT: 3:44 PM
  * Arrive LAX: 6:03 PM (Duration: 5 hr 19 min, Nonstop)
- Return: Monday, Oct 5, 2026 | UA 2039
  * Depart LAX: 9:00 AM
  * Arrive PIT: 4:46 PM (Duration: 4 hr 46 min, Nonstop)
- Open Tab: Google Flights LAX Booking Summary (Tab ID: 787783793)

Option B (Alternative Direct to Destination): Pittsburgh (PIT) to Palm Springs (PSP)
- Airline: Southwest (Outbound) / Delta (Return) (1-Stop)
- Price: $495 total
- Outbound: Thursday, Oct 1, 2026 | Southwest WN 1793 / WN 4651
  * Depart PIT: 7:20 PM | Arrive PSP: 11:35 PM (1 stop in LAS, 7 hr 15 min)
- Return: Monday, Oct 5, 2026 | Delta DL 4030 / DL 1188
  * Depart PSP: 6:03 AM | Arrive PIT: 4:33 PM (1 stop in SLC, 7 hr 30 min)
- Open Tab: Google Flights PSP Booking Summary (Tab ID: 787784060)

KEY AIRPORT ANALYSIS & DRIVING WINDOW ASSESSMENT:
- Flying into PSP skips the 130-mile drive from LA to Palm Springs entirely because the airport is right in Palm Springs (5-10 min from town).
- However, PSP has NO nonstop flights from Pittsburgh, has a late arrival (11:35 PM), an early return (6:03 AM), and completely precludes the culinary detour to Los Angeles restaurants (Soban or Holbox).
- Flying into LAX provides the only NONSTOP flight option (as prioritized). Because the flight lands at 6:03 PM—after the 4:00 PM driving window cutoff—driving to Palm Springs that evening would violate the 9am-4pm rule and force you into heavy evening freeway traffic.
- Solution: Stay overnight at an airport hotel near LAX on Thursday night, then make the drive on Friday morning between 9:00 AM and 4:00 PM, allowing for the recommended lunch detour at Holbox.

================================================================================
2. OVERNIGHT HOTEL NEAR LAX (OCTOBER 1–2)
================================================================================
- Hotel: Courtyard by Marriott Los Angeles LAX / Century Boulevard
- Address: 6161 West Century Boulevard, Los Angeles, CA 90045 (0.5 miles from LAX)
- Rate: $162 / night (1 night: Check-in Thu Oct 1, Check-out Fri Oct 2)
- Rating: 8.1 / 10 ("Very Good", 1,864+ reviews)
- Amenities: Free airport shuttle every 15 min, soundproof rooms, on-site Bistro & bar, fitness center.
- Open Tab: Booking.com Property Listing (Tab ID: 787784062)

================================================================================
3. CAR RENTAL AT LAX (OCTOBER 1–5)
================================================================================
- Vehicle Type: Intermediate – Ford Focus (or similar, 5 seats, 4 bags, 4 doors, automatic)
- Provider: Expedia / KAYAK
- Rate: $21 / day ($84 total for 4 days: Oct 1 – Oct 5)
- Features: Unlimited mileage, full-to-full fuel policy
- Pickup: Thursday, Oct 1 at LAX
- Drop-off: Monday, Oct 5 at LAX (by 7:00 AM prior to 9:00 AM flight)
- Open Tab: Kayak Car Rental Listing Details (Tab ID: 787784063)

================================================================================
4. RESTAURANT DETOUR EVALUATION: HOLBOX VS. SOBAN
================================================================================
- Distance & Route from LAX to Palm Springs: ~130 miles via I-10 E (approx. 2 hr 15 min – 2 hr 45 min normal traffic).
- Candidate 1: Soban (4001 W Olympic Blvd, Koreatown, Los Angeles)
  * Detour details: LAX to Soban is ~12-14 miles through congested surface street traffic (Crenshaw/Olympic, ~35-50 min). From Soban to Palm Springs is ~116 miles (~2 hr 15 min). Total route: 126 miles, ~3 hr 15 min driving.
  * Experience: Traditional Korean sit-down dining (famous for raw marinated crab / ganjang gejang and galbi jjim). Requires 1 to 1.5 hours for table service.
- Candidate 2: Holbox (3655 S Grand Ave #C9, Mercado La Paloma, Los Angeles)
  * Detour details: From LAX, take I-105 E to I-110 N directly to Exposition Park (14 miles, ~20-25 min freeway). Holbox sits 1 mile from the I-10 East on-ramp, leading directly to Palm Springs (114 miles, ~1 hr 50 min). Total route: 128 miles, ~3 hr driving.
  * Experience: Michelin-recognized Yucatan seafood counter inside Mercado La Paloma (octopus tacos, aguachile, ceviche, scallop tacos). Fast-casual format allows for a swift 45-minute meal. Opens at 11:30 AM.
- RECOMMENDATION: Holbox is the clear winner. It sits directly on the freeway interchange corridor between LAX and I-10 East, adding virtually zero detour compared to cutting into Koreatown. Its counter service ensures you can eat lunch between 11:30 AM and 12:15 PM and arrive in Palm Springs by 2:30 PM, safely within the 9:00 AM – 4:00 PM driving window.

================================================================================
5. DAY-BY-DAY ITINERARY
================================================================================
Thursday, October 1, 2026: Nonstop Flight to LA & Hotel Check-in
- 3:44 PM: Depart Pittsburgh International Airport (PIT) on United UA 2055.
- 6:03 PM: Land at Los Angeles International Airport (LAX).
- 6:30 PM: Pick up rental car (Ford Focus / Intermediate, $21/day) at LAX facility.
- 7:15 PM: Check in to Courtyard by Marriott LAX / Century Boulevard (6161 W Century Blvd).
- Evening: Dinner at hotel Bistro / nearby, relax and avoid nighttime driving to Palm Springs.

Friday, October 2, 2026: Morning Departure, Holbox Lunch & Drive to Palm Springs
- 9:00 AM – 10:30 AM: Wake up, breakfast, check out of Courtyard LAX.
- 10:45 AM: Begin drive east (strictly within the 9am-4pm window). Take I-105 E to I-110 N.
- 11:15 AM: Arrive at Mercado La Paloma / Holbox (3655 S Grand Ave).
- 11:30 AM – 12:15 PM: Lunch at Holbox right at opening (fresh scallop ceviche, pulpo tacos).
- 12:15 PM: Get on I-10 East towards San Bernardino and Palm Springs.
- 2:30 PM: Arrive in Palm Springs, CA (well before the 4:00 PM cutoff). Check in to accommodations.
- Evening: Attend welcome dinner / rehearsal festivities.

Saturday, October 3, 2026: WEDDING DAY in Palm Springs
- Daytime: Relax by the pool, explore downtown Palm Springs or the Palm Springs Aerial Tramway.
- Afternoon / Evening: Attend the Wedding ceremony, reception, and party!

Sunday, October 4, 2026: Palm Springs & Drive Back to LA
- Morning: Farewell brunch with the wedding couple and guests.
- 11:30 AM: Depart Palm Springs via I-10 West back towards Los Angeles.
- 2:15 PM: Arrive in the LAX / Westside area (safely driving between 9am and 4pm).
- Evening: Dinner in Los Angeles; stay near LAX or prepare for early morning flight.

Monday, October 5, 2026: Return Nonstop Flight to Pittsburgh
- 7:00 AM: Return rental car at LAX and head to United terminal.
- 9:00 AM: Depart LAX on United Flight UA 2039 (Nonstop, 4 hr 46 min).
- 4:46 PM: Land at Pittsburgh International Airport (PIT) by the 5th as required.
`;
